name: qfd_c_ring514_rpf-rpf-COMMIT
purpose: Structural shape re-hardening for frozen CB16 slot: same source/params/edges, independent geometry review before gate

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qfd_c_ring514 u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/physical/qcluster/qfd_c_land_k.sv rtl/physical/qcluster/qfd_c_ring_t.sv && echo lint-ok

bench.name: ring_exact
bench.pass_regex: RING_BENCH PASS qfd_c_ring514 0 errors in 20000 cycles

bench.name: ring_mutant_k3
bench.fail_regex: RING_BENCH FAIL qfd_c_ring514 [1-9]\d* errors in 20000 cycles

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_ring514_rpf/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_ring514_rpf/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_c_ring514_rpf --out {RUN}/record/views/qfd_c_ring514  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: Re-harden existing qualified child source at new shape to fit frozen CB16 rpf channels; same top/params/sources, zero logical or reset/data/clock-cycle change. No current view alias; must receive own native/gate/route/export qualification. QW-CB16REG 10-20 main line (a): every CB16 region crossing becomes ONE hard tile = writer ring qfd_c_land_w1k on the source region clock ck_w + reader qfd_c_land_r1k (incl. its output register) on the destination clock ck_r, W=514, D 4, K 2; 69 crossings, 2 masters.  Why: the flat soft rings gave each region root 6.7k-20.9k ring flops over 1-2 mm -> within-region TT spread 410-813 ps, WNS -1.4..-1.7 ns after 10-16 h (fulln/fullnb/fullm).  Tile gate r0 (108 x 64.8) 10-20: WARN only (util), TT/FF spread 12/12 ps, setup +288 ps, GRT ovf 0; outline now 108 x 43.2.  A split form (reader output register as a separate station) was dropped: a two-domain combinational tile output fails the OT_MULTI_ROOT output-domain contract.  0 added cycles.
